title: ₹5,000 for 10 Grams, Says the AI (Creative 27) (Telugu audio)

t.ask: What is the price of 10 grams of 22-carat gold in India today?
chunks: The price of gold can fluctuate daily ... I recommend checking a local or online gold dealer in India.
However, as of my last update in October 2023, the price per gram of 22-carat gold in India is typically around INR 450 to INR 500
10 grams would be approximately INR 4,500 ... INR 5,000.
Please note that these prices are illustrative and may not reflect current market values.

lines.text: పది గ్రాములకి ఐదు వేలు అంటోంది చాట్‌బాట్! [1] మీ బోర్డు మీద లక్షా ఇరవై ఎనిమిది వేలా?!
lines.show: ₹5,000 for 10 grams, says the chatbot! And your board says ₹1,28,150?!

lines.text: అమ్మా, ఇది దివ్య పెళ్ళి నెక్లెస్, గొడవ కాదు. [1] ఫోన్ ఇవ్వమ్మా.
lines.show: Amma, this is Divya's wedding necklace, not a fight. Give me the phone.

lines.show: That's an October 2023 figure. Even then, 10 grams was ₹55,000. <pause 0.5> One zero short!
